measured.consequence: unguarded; the U12 VOUT relief run slotted the island, KiCad re-poured around the slot and U12.1 came away on a 0.473 mm2 island of its own -- BQ25185_SYS 7 -> 8

defects.name: ANCHOR_NEED_NOT_BE_A_PAD
defects.was: every island bonding fewer than TWO PADS was skipped before either clause was consulted
defects.why_wrong: the NO_ESCAPE clause protects a dead pad back to the nearest anchor that CAN be re-bonded, and its own comment names a VIA as such an anchor; copper joining a dead pad to a via is exactly as fatal to cut as copper joining it to another pad

effect.cap: no point exceeds tube_radius + zone_clearance = 0.375 mm, the figure every tube on this board already used

defects.name: A_TUBE_HAS_A_WIDTH_PER_POINT
defects.was: the single erosion radius the WHOLE path survives was published as the keepout at every point of it
defects.why_wrong: that figure is the width of the NARROWEST place on the path, so every wider stretch was under-protected

defects.effect: with the mask corrected, NO barrel of any rung of BRIDGE_LADDER lands inside the +3V3 body near U12 except the 0.35/0.20 mm fine-pitch process -- evidence/d610-vout-grid.json

measured.consequence: the barrel's antipad ate the tube; KiCad's refill pruned what was left and U12.1 went open

defects.name: A_BARREL_IS_NOT_A_TRACK
defects.was: Field.via_ok was ANDed with the guard mask built from the TRACK width, over the layers this net may ROUTE on
defects.why_wrong: a through barrel is copper on EVERY layer and is more than three times as wide as the track; it owes keepout + via_dia/2, not keepout + width/2

why: Two independent defects in the pour-bond guard, each measured, each the direct cause of the BQ25185_SYS clause-4 regression that refused D-609 and D-610's first two gate runs.
